subject: Order form: pricing ladder reconciliation, invoice recipient & tax evidence
messages:
From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@greengrid.com>
To: nikhil_sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-02-03T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Order form: pricing ladder reconciliation & invoice/residency questions

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks for the draft order form. A couple of quick items our finance team flagged before we loop legal:

- Pricing ladder: the committed spend tiers on Appendix A don't match the quote export we received (line items showing quarterly credits). Can you confirm which set drives invoice amounts?
- Invoice recipient: our accounting requires invoices to be issued to GreenGrid Holdings (US entity) but PO routing may come from GreenGrid Europe. We need a fallback path if the remit entity differs.
- Taxes: to avoid VAT withholding, finance asked for Redwood's tax residency / VAT registration or instructions on where to remit gross vs net.

We've attached our annotated orderform (orderform_redline_v1.pdf). Can you loop in your legal and finance so we can get this turned around quickly?

Best,
Alex Ramos
Procurement Manager
GreenGrid Inc.

Attachment: orderform_redline_v1.pdf (pdf, 212KB)

From: nikhil_sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@greengrid.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-02-03T12:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Order form: pricing ladder reconciliation & invoice/residency questions

Hi Alex — thanks for the notes and the redlines. Looping in Kimberly (legal) and Ben (AE) to confirm the billing flow and any necessary contract language. Laura from finance is also on copy to confirm acceptable invoice recipient logic.

Quick proposals to speed this up:
1) Pricing authority: the most recent quote export should govern invoice line items; we'll attach a reconciliation doc to show mapping from quote -> Appendix A. If that works, legal can add a short sentence in the order form that Appendix A is authoritative for billing.
2) Invoice fallback: propose a clause that allows invoices to be reissued to a designated paying entity within 30 days of invoice receipt; this preserves the billing event while allowing GreenGrid to provide a PO/credit to the correct remit entity.
3) Taxes: please send us GreenGrid's tax cert for the remit entity (VAT/GST registration). We'll share our tax residency statement and Redwood's UK VAT registration if you need it.

Ben — can you draft an MAP (mutual action plan) for PO + tax evidence + signature and a target timeline?

Thanks,
Nikhil Sharma
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: nikhil_sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>, Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@greengrid.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-02-03T15:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Order form: pricing ladder reconciliation & invoice/residency questions

Hi all — reviewed the redline and Alex's items. High-level from Legal:

- Pricing ladder: we can accept language that Appendix A governs billing provided we attach a one-page mapping (quote -> Appendix A) to the order form. I'll attach a short "billing mapping" exhibit to the order form for signature.
- Invoice recipient/fallback: redline to add a clause: "If invoiced to an affiliate other than the Paying Entity, Paying Entity shall provide written notice within 30 days and Redwood will reissue the invoice to the Paying Entity without prejudice to payment terms." This keeps cash recourse but addresses your PO flows.
- Net terms: Redwood is ok with Net30 for this deal size, conditional on a credit check and PO by signature.
- Taxes: we need GreenGrid to provide proof of VAT registration for the entity that will remit. If GreenGrid expects Redwood to gross-up or accept withholding, please document the expected withholding percentage and statutory reference so Finance can price accordingly.

I've attached our proposed legal redlines (legal_redlines.docx) and a 1-page billing mapping template. If Alex confirms acceptance of the fallback clause and provides the VAT cert, we can fold these into a DocuSign-ready package today.

— Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: legal_redlines.docx (docx, 48KB)

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Alex / team — happy to run a short MAP to close this week. Proposed milestones: 
1) Today: GreenGrid confirms which legal entity will sign + attaches VAT cert for remit entity (Sophie?).
2) Tomorrow: Redwood returns order form with the billing mapping exhibit + legal redlines incorporated.
3) +2 days: GreenGrid approves redline, returns PO and signs via DocuSign.
4) Invoice issued within 5 business days of signature to the remit entity; if remit entity differs from PO, reissue per clause.

HubSpot: I have deal GG-2025-1147 at stage "legal review" — I will advance it if we get the VAT cert and PO. Sophie, can you confirm if your procurement team can share the VAT cert in this thread?

Thanks — attaching the MAP template for clarity.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
